name: @ambient/bridge
description: Standalone Ambient Bridge desktop app for WorkOS auth, local IPC pairing, and inference egress.
author: Ambient

scripts.build:mac:dir: pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.build:mac:dir:dev: pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml --mac dir
scripts.build:linux:dir:dev: pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml --linux dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:release:mac: pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:release:win: pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:release:win:local: pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.local.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:release:win:arm64:local: cross-env AMBIENT_DESKTOP_VARIANT=local pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && pnpm posthog:sourcemaps && electron-builder --config electron-builder.local.yml --win nsis --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test:electron: pnpm generate:build-config && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm generate:build-config && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
